overview_description.description: Myntra operates as an e-commerce platform focused on fashion, lifestyle, and beauty products. It offers a wide selection of apparel, footwear, accessories, and personal care items across various domestic and international brands. The platform supports shopping through both web and mobile applications, featuring category filters, style guides, and personalization tools to enhance user experience. Myntra also provides services like Myntra Studio for curated content and Myntra Insider, a loyalty program that rewards customer engagement. The company partners with brands to enable digital storefronts and uses data insights for inventory and trend forecasting. It facilitates returns, exchanges, and multiple payment options, including EMI and digital wallets. Myntra is part of a larger e-commerce ecosystem that integrates logistics, technology, and marketing for online retail.
